text:
Nora: quick RFC follow-up - I'm proposing an "intake-validator-lite" CI gate. Purpose: extremely cheap deterministic checks that catch tokenization/manifest/regression bombs before a model hits full smoke.
Ravi: short and cheap is good. how cheap?
Nora: target <8s wall, <0.15 GPU-min when registry cache hits. run on tiny-gpu or cpu-fallback. skip quant if registry has precomputed quant artifacts.
Lena: what checks are you planning?
Nora: manifest sha256 checks for each binary, tokenizer file presence + vocab-size sanity, sentinel special tokens present and stable ids, 3 sampled forwards (32,512,2048 by default) with deterministic decode (seed=42, temp=0, top_k=1), and a tiny golden-set semantic check (10 prompts).
Marco: sampling 2048 worries me for CI cost.
Nora: only single forward at that seqlen and decode limited to 2 tokens. cost bounded; keeps long-seq failure detection.
Ravi: quant parity is always messy - float vs int8 can diverge.
Nora: two-tier comparator: (1) token-match metrics (token-match rate, edit-distance) and tokenizer checksum diff; (2) semantic fallback using sentence embeddings (cosine) on golden set. PASS rules: embed_cosine >= 0.94 OR token_match >= 0.9. if both low -> fail to smokehouse.
Lena: how do we reduce false positives from benign tokenization tweaks?
Nora: require both signals to be bad before hard fail, except for sentinel-token problems (missing eos/pad/bos/unk) which are immediate fail. Also emit a short diff summary and heuristics to highlight punctuation-only shifts.
QA-bot: validator-lite triggered for PR #1345 on tiny-pool :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ravi: telemetry hooks?
Nora: publish token-level latency p50/p95 for each sampled seqlen, peak RSS estimate, and cache_hit boolean + quant_cache_key. Also KV-cache warmup step so cached-paths exercised.
Marco: failure flow?
Nora: on FAIL we auto-label the PR `validator-lite:fail` and attach the fingerprint + concise diff. Owner must triage. For perf regressions we provide a one-click pin in the intake pipeline to keep prior stable quant artifact. Add `validator-lite:ignore-ttl` label for temporary exceptions that auto-expire.
Lena: CLI/implementation?
Nora: prototype CLI: `intake-validator-lite run --manifest manifest.json --gold gold.json --out fingerprint.txt`. Fingerprint is a single-line CSV-ish string for quick parsing. Example emitted fingerprint snippet in logs:
```
fp=sha256:abcd1234;seqlens=32,512,2048;perf_ms=7,45,230;tok_match=0.93;embed_cos=0.96;cache_hit=true
```
Ravi: good. please ensure deterministic sampling and document MODEL_INTAKE_SEED env var. Also add a small randomized jitter in CI scheduling to avoid thundering herd.
Nora: will do. I'll push a minimal Py prototype and a unit test suite that uses cached artifacts to avoid cloud spend. Tagging @Marco for seqlen thresholds review.
Marco: will take a look this afternoon. :eyes:
